ABORT_DETACHED_QUERY: If true, Snowflake will automatically abort queries when it detects that the client has disappeared.
ACCOUNT_LEVEL_FILE_EXTENSIONS_ALLOW_LIST: File extensions that are allowed in private workspaces for the account. Format: '.ext1, .ext2'. Use '<NO_EXTENSION>' to allow files without extensions. If empty, all extensions are allowed
File extensions that are allowed in shared workspaces for the account. Format: '.ext1, .ext2'. Use '<NO_EXTENSION>' to allow files without extensions. If empty, all extensions are allowed
ACTIVE_PYTHON_PROFILER: Which profiler is currently active to analyze user code for Python sprocs. Possible values are "LINE" and "MEMORY".
AI_EXTRACT_PREVIEW_072026_ENABLED: If true, AI_EXTRACT runs arctic-extract followed by per-question inference
AI_SETTINGS: YAML configuration for AI settings. Supports guardrails with advanced_prompt_injection rules and pii_detection legs.
AI_SQL_EMBED_SIMILARITY_ERROR_HANDLING_U: When enabled, old fail on error behavior will be observed for AI_EMBED and AI_SIMILARITY
AI_SQL_ERROR_HANDLING_USE_FAIL_ON_ERROR: When enabled, old fail on error behavior will be observed
ALLOWED_NOTEBOOKS_RUNTIMES: Comma-separated allowlist of notebook runtime container image refs an account admin permits notebooks to run on. Empty means no allowlist. Each entry must match an existing notebook runtime environment.
ALLOWED_SPCS_WORKLOAD_TYPES: Comma separated list of allowed workload types on SPCS. Valid workload types are as follows: ALL, USER, NOTEBOOK, MODEL_SERVING, STREAMLIT, ML_JOB
ALLOW_BIND_VALUES_ACCESS: Allow any form of bind value access to users. This parameter should be set to false at the ACCOUNT level for customers who want to disable bind value access altogether. Each access path (e.g., BIND_VALUE table function, QUERY_HISTORY, etc.) also has its own parameter guarding access (these parameters have 'and' semantics: both this parameter and the access-path specific parameter must be enabled in order for a user to get access).
ALLOW_CLIENT_MFA_CACHING: Allows client to cache MFA Authentication
ALLOW_DOCKERHUB_PACKAGE_DOWNLOAD: Allow remote build services to pull base images from Docker Hub. When true, egress to Docker Hub endpoints is automatically granted to REMOTE_BUILD jobs without requiring an explicit EAI.
ALLOW_ID_TOKEN: Whether the account can have ID Tokens issued
ALLOW_NPM_PACKAGE_DOWNLOAD: Allow remote build services to download npm packages and frontend CDN assets (Google Fonts). When true, egress to registry.npmjs.org, fonts.googleapis.com, and fonts.gstatic.com is automatically granted to REMOTE_BUILD jobs without requiring an explicit EAI.
ALLOW_ROW_TIMESTAMP: Support row timestamp on table. If set on schema level and higher, the callbacks below will not perform table specific validations and not affect existing tables.  New tables will be created with row timestamp enabled.
ALLOW_V3_EXPRESSION_DEFAULTS: When true, allows non-constant expression default values on V3 Iceberg columns. Expression defaults are evaluated by Snowflake at write time only. External engines see no default and must supply values or get NULL.
APPSTREAM_IP_LIST: List of IPs used by Appstream to access customer accounts.
AUTOCOMMIT:
The autocommit property determines whether is statement should to be implicitly
wrapped within a transaction or not. If autocommit is set to true, then a 
statement that requires a transaction is executed within a transaction 
implicitly. If autocommit is off then an explicit commit or rollback is required
to close a transaction. The default autocommit value is true.
AUTOCOMMIT_API_SUPPORTED:
Whether autocommit feature is enabled for this client. This parameter is for
Snowflake use only.
BASE_LOCATION_PREFIX: The base location prefix for managed or converted Iceberg table data relative to the Iceberg tables' external volume active storage location
BUDGETS_DATABASE: Configured value of the database to be used for all budgets purposes for an account.
CATALOG: Name of the catalog integration to use for iceberg tables
CATALOG_SYNC: Name of the catalog integration to sync this table
CHANGE_TRACKING_DEFAULT: When true, CREATE TABLE / CTAS that omit the CHANGE_TRACKING clause create the table with change tracking enabled. An explicit CHANGE_TRACKING clause in the DDL still wins.
CLIENT_ENABLE_CONSERVATIVE_MEMORY_USAGE: Enables conservative memory usage for JDBC
CLIENT_ENABLE_DEFAULT_OVERWRITE_IN_PUT: Set default value of overwrite option to true for put command, if overwrite option is not specified in the sql command.
CLIENT_ENABLE_LOG_INFO_STATEMENT_PARAMET: Enable info-level logging for Prepared Statement binding parameters
CLIENT_ENCRYPTION_KEY_SIZE: Client-side encryption key size in bits. Either 128 or 256.
CLIENT_MEMORY_LIMIT: Limit the amount of memory used by the client in MB
CLIENT_METADATA_REQUEST_USE_CONNECTION_C: For client metadata request(getTables()), use session catalog and schema if set to true
CLIENT_METADATA_USE_SESSION_DATABASE: For client metadata request(getTables()), use session catalog but multiple schemas if set to true (in conjunction with CLIENT_METADATA_REQUEST_USE_CONNECTION_CTX
CLIENT_RESULT_CHUNK_SIZE: Set the max result chunk size in MB on the client side
CLIENT_RESULT_COLUMN_CASE_INSENSITIVE: Column name search is case insensitive in clients
CLIENT_SESSION_CLONE: If true, client clones a new session from the previously used tokens for the account and user.
CLIENT_SESSION_KEEP_ALIVE: If true, client session will not expire automatically
CLIENT_SESSION_KEEP_ALIVE_HEARTBEAT_FREQ: Heartbeat frequency in seconds for CLIENT_SESSION_KEEP_ALIVE.
CLIENT_TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING:
If a variable is bound to the TIMESTAMP data type using the bind API, determines which TIMESTAMP* type it should map to:
  TIMESTAMP_LTZ (default), TIMESTAMP_NTZ
COCO_CLOUD_AGENTS_NON_SNOWFLAKE_EGRESS_D: If true, disable non-Snowflake network egress from CoCo Cloud Agents for the entire account. Defaults to false (egress allowed). Account admins can set this to true to block non-Snowflake destinations from Cloud Agent tool executions.
COCO_SNOWSIGHT_ALLOW_ALL_PERMISSION_OPTI: If true, disable the allow-all behavior for permission options in CoCo Snowsight for the entire account. Defaults to false (allow-all enabled). Account admins can set this to true to require explicit permission checks for CoCo Snowsight tool executions.
CORTEX_AGENT_SANDBOX_DEFAULT_ON: BCR: When true, agents get a sandbox on every request even without a code_execution tool in the agent spec, and the agent spec accepts a top-level sandbox_config section. Also read by Snowsight to hide the code_execution toggle and show the Sandbox Configuration section.
CORTEX_CLIENT_READ_ONLY: Client-settable strict read-only mode. When enabled, only SELECT, EXPLAIN, SHOW, and DESCRIBE statements are allowed. Cannot be disabled once set.
CORTEX_CODE_CLI_DAILY_EST_CREDIT_LIMIT_P: Daily estimated credit limit per user for Cortex Code CLI usage. A value of -1 means no limit. A value of 0 disables access.
CORTEX_CODE_DESKTOP_DAILY_EST_CREDIT_LIM: Daily estimated credit limit per user for Cortex Code Desktop usage. A value of -1 means no limit. A value of 0 disables access.
CORTEX_CODE_SNOWSIGHT_DAILY_EST_CREDIT_L: Daily estimated credit limit per user for Cortex Code Snowsight usage. A value of -1 means no limit. A value of 0 disables access.
CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION: Comma separated list of allowed cortex cross regions. Order does not matter.
CORTEX_MCP_SERVER_FORCE_SQL_EXEC_READ_ON: When true, forces SQL execution tool to be read-only at the account level, overriding any per-tool config. This allows account admins to guarantee that MCP SQL execution cannot perform writes.
CORTEX_MODELS_ALLOWLIST: Can be ALL, NONE, or a comma separated list of model names
CSV_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT: Display format for TIMESTAMP values in Snowsight downloaded CSV files. If empty, TIMESTAMP_LTZ_OUTPUT_FORMAT will be used for TIMESTAMP_LTZ values, TIMESTAMP_TZ_OUTPUT_FORMAT will be used for TIMESTAMP_TZ and TIMESTAMP_NTZ_OUTPUT_FORMAT for TIMESTAMP_NTZ values.
C_API_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to C API
DATAFRAME_PROCESSOR_PKG_VERSION: The version of the Dataframe processor package. e.g., local means the package is built locally from a stage; latest means use the latest version imported from the Anaconda channel. 0.0.3 means the exact version from the channel.
DATA_METRIC_SCHEDULE: Specify the schedule that data metric functions associated to the table must be executed in order to be used for evaluation.
DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS: number of days to retain the old version of deleted/updated data
DEFAULT_DBT_VERSION: Default dbt version to use when creating and executing dbt projects
DEFAULT_DDL_COLLATION: Collation that is used for all the new columns created by the DDL statements (if not specified)
DEFAULT_MAX_PER_USER_CONCURRENT_STATEMEN: When set to a non-zero value and ENABLE_FEATURE_WAREHOUSE_CONCURRENT_STATEMENT_LIMIT is enabled for the account, warehouses without an explicit max_per_user_concurrent_statement_limit will use this as their effective limit at runtime, provided ENABLE_DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE_CONCURRENT_STATEMENT_LIMIT is also enabled.
DEFAULT_METADATA_WRITE_FORMAT: Default metadata write format for tables created in this database or schema. Valid values: SNOWFLAKE, ICEBERG. Note: catalog-linked databases (CLDs) always promote CREATE TABLE DDLs to Iceberg implicitly, regardless of this parameter's stored value. The parameter cannot be modified on a CLD.
DEFAULT_NOTEBOOK_COMPUTE_POOL_CPU: The default CPU compute pool used to run Notebooks.
DEFAULT_NOTEBOOK_COMPUTE_POOL_GPU: The default GPU compute pool used to run Notebooks.
DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING: User-visible parameter that allows customizing null ordering:- FIRST: nulls are ordered first in ASC order and last in DESC order- LAST: nulls are ordered last in ASC order and first in ASC order
DEFAULT_PYTHON_ARTIFACT_REPOSITORY: Default Python artifact repository for account workloads
DEFAULT_SNOWFLAKE_APPS_BUILD_COMPUTE_POO: Default compute pool for building Snowflake Apps Docker images.
DEFAULT_SNOWFLAKE_APPS_BUILD_EXTERNAL_AC: Default external access integration for Snowflake Apps builds that require external network access. Empty string means build without external access.
DEFAULT_SNOWFLAKE_APPS_DESTINATION_DATAB: Default database where Snowflake Apps are created. Empty string means the CLI uses the personal database (USER$<login_name>).
DEFAULT_SNOWFLAKE_APPS_DESTINATION_SCHEM: Default schema within the destination database for Snowflake Apps. Empty string means the CLI uses PUBLIC.
DEFAULT_SNOWFLAKE_APPS_QUERY_WAREHOUSE: Default warehouse for Snowflake Apps SQL queries during deployment. Empty string means the CLI uses the current session warehouse.
DEFAULT_SNOWFLAKE_APPS_SERVICE_COMPUTE_P: Default compute pool for running deployed Snowflake Apps services.
DEFAULT_STREAMLIT_APP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECON: Account-admin-configurable default idle-timeout (seconds) for Streamlit apps that have not set IDLE_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_TIME_SECONDS. 0 = system default. Valid non-zero range: 86400 (1 day) to 604800 (7 days). Requires ENABLE_STREAMLIT_LIFECYCLE_CONTROLS_FEATURE.
DEFAULT_STREAMLIT_COMPUTE_POOL: Specifies the default compute pool for Streamlit applications.
DEFAULT_STREAMLIT_NOTEBOOK_WAREHOUSE: The warehouse to run streamlits/notebooks if the WAREHOUSE property is not explicitly specified on the streamlit/notebook objects
DISABLE_CREATE_APPLICATION_SERVICE_ON_CO: When enabled, CREATE APPLICATION SERVICE that runs on a compute pool is rejected: COMPUTE_POOL is given, the account default pool is used, or COMPUTE_RESOURCE resolves to MANAGED_COMPUTE_POOL. Existing services and COMPUTE_RESOURCE = SERVERLESS creates are not affected. An account admin can set this with ALTER ACCOUNT.
DISABLE_EXECUTE_DATA_METRIC_FUNCTION_GRA: When true, prevents Snowflake from automatically granting EXECUTE DATA METRIC FUNCTION to the SNOWFLAKE.PUBLIC application role. Set to TRUE to opt out of the default grant; the setting takes effect during the next setup or upgrade.
DISABLE_MFA_ENROLLMENT_PROMPT: When true, users with a local password who are unenrolled with multifactor authentication (MFA) will not receive a dismissable prompt at login to enroll in MFA.
DISABLE_SNOWFLAKE_LOCAL_APPLICATION_INTE: When set, disables the SNOWFLAKE$LOCAL_APPLICATION integration
DISABLE_UI_DOWNLOAD_BUTTON: Disables the Classic UI download button
DISABLE_USER_PRIVILEGE_GRANTS: If true, disallow granting privileges to a user.
DISALLOWED_SPCS_WORKLOAD_TYPES: Comma separated list of disallowed workload types on SPCS. Valid workload types are as follows: ALL, USER, NOTEBOOK, MODEL_SERVING, STREAMLIT, ML_JOB
DOTNET_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to .NET driver
ENABLE_AUTOMATIC_SENSITIVE_DATA_CLASSIFI: If true, events from automatic sensitive data classification will get logged in user event table
ENABLE_BUDGET_EVENT_LOGGING: When true, enable budget event logging feature
ENABLE_CONSOLE_OUTPUT: Enable stdout/stderr fast path logging for anonyous stored procs. This is a public parameter (similar to LOG_LEVEL).
ENABLE_CORTEX_AGENTS_ANSWERS: Is the Cortex Answers feature enabled in Agent API.
ENABLE_CORTEX_ANALYST_MODEL_AZURE_OPENAI: Whether to allow models from Azure OpenAI (e.g. GPT-4) when serving Cortex Analyst API requests or to only use Snowflake-hosted models.
ENABLE_CORTEX_AUTOMATIC_DATABASE_DESCRIP: When true, enables automatic Cortex-powered database descriptions. Account admins can set this to false to disable the feature for their account.
ENABLE_CORTEX_AUTOMATIC_SCHEMA_DESCRIPTI: When true, enables automatic Cortex-powered schema descriptions. Account admins can set this to false to disable the feature for their account.
ENABLE_CORTEX_AUTOMATIC_TABLE_DESCRIPTIO: When true, enables automatic Cortex-powered table descriptions. Account admins can set this to false to disable the feature for their account.
ENABLE_CORTEX_EMAIL_ATTACHMENTS: Whether Cortex may send email attachments on this account. An account admin can turn this off before any attachment is sent.
ENABLE_CORTEX_TOOLS_ADVANCED_GOVERNANCE: Enables the Cortex Tools Advanced Governance add-on, which provides enhanced governance and policy controls for Cortex Tools. Enabling this add-on incurs additional charges. Disabling it turns those controls off: any Advanced Governance configuration stops applying and must be set up again if you re-enable.
ENABLE_CORTEX_WEBSEARCH: Set to true to allow Cortex products to use web search
ENABLE_DATA_COMPACTION: User-visible parameter that controls table storage optimization for managed Iceberg tables.
ENABLE_DEFAULT_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION: When false, SNOWFLAKE$DEFAULT_EMAIL stays disabled even after ENABLE_DEFAULT_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_INTEGRATION is turned on. ACCOUNTADMIN can set this before that BCR is enabled.
ENABLE_DUAL_STACK_LOAD_BALANCER: Enables dual-stack load balancer for public traffic
ENABLE_EGRESS_COST_OPTIMIZER: If true, replication cache will get applied automatically for the account
ENABLE_FBE_GET_EXACT_FILE_MATCH: When set, a file GET on a versioned (FBE) stage matches the requested path exactly (equals) instead of by prefix, returning exactly one file or none. Intended for single-file downloads: it stops a single-file GET from over-matching prefix siblings (e.g. profiles.yml vs profiles.yml.template) and folder children (SNOW-3637888). Set it only on sessions issuing single-file requests -- while set, a directory/prefix GET matches no files. No effect on non-versioned stages.
ENABLE_GET_DDL_USE_DATA_TYPE_ALIAS: If true, GET_DDL will return data type alias instead of canonical data type when alias is available
ENABLE_GLUE_NATIVE_COMMENT_CATALOG_COMMI: Whether table and column comment changes are committed to the external catalog for Iceberg tables using AWS Glue catalog integrations outside catalog-linked databases. When disabled, comment changes are stored only in Snowflake. Does not affect managed Iceberg tables, catalog-linked databases, or Iceberg REST catalog integrations. Enabling requires the catalog IAM role to grant Glue read, describe, and write permissions, including glue:GetCatalog.
ENABLE_HORIZON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ADVERTISE: If true, Horizon IRC advertises an idempotency-key-lifetime for this database, so Iceberg clients send an Idempotency-Key on commits and retry them safely. Has no effect unless ENABLE_HORIZON_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY is on. Default off.
ENABLE_HORIZON_IRC_UNMANAGED_CREDENTIAL_: If true, enables Horizon IRC access with credential vending for unmanaged Iceberg tables in this database. When false (default), the tables are not accessible via Horizon IRC with credential vending.
ENABLE_ICEBERG_MERGE_ON_READ: Deprecated. Use ICEBERG_MERGE_ON_READ_BEHAVIOR to control merge-on-read on Iceberg tables.
ENABLE_INTERNAL_STAGES_PRIVATELINK: Enables privatelink access to Snowflake internal stages
ENABLE_LISTING_SHARE_RESTRICTIONS: If true, enable share restrictions for all private external listings owned by this account, which will block new data sharing from BUSINESS_CRITICAL+ edition to lower edition accounts, or from HIPAA to non-HIPAA accounts.
ENABLE_LS_SOURCE_METADATA_COLUMNS: Enable the source_size and source_md5 columns in LIST output for versioned stages.
ENABLE_NATIVE_TABLE_OVERRIDE_DEFAULT: If true, suppresses implicit DEFAULT_METADATA_WRITE_FORMAT and ADDITIONAL_METADATA_READ_FORMATS augmentation for the current session. CREATE TABLE creates a plain FDN table regardless of schema-level defaults. Explicit CREATE ICEBERG TABLE is unaffected. No-op for catalog-linked databases (CLDs), which cannot create FDN tables.
ENABLE_NOTEBOOK_CREATION_IN_PERSONAL_DB: If enabled, notebook can be created in personal DB
ENABLE_NOTEBOOK_SERVICE_BLOCK_STORAGE_VO: Enable the persistent block-storage volume on notebook services.
ENABLE_NOTEBOOK_SERVICE_REMOTE_VS_CODE_A: Enable remote access development on notebook services with vs code.
ENABLE_PER_ACCOUNT_APP_SERVICE_PRIVATELI: If true, privatelink app service traffic like SiS, SPCS or any service using *.snowflake.app will use hostnames containing the account name
ENABLE_PER_ACCOUNT_APP_SERVICE_URL: If true, public app service traffic like SiS, SPCS or any service using *.snowflake.app will use hostnames containing the account name
ENABLE_PROVIDER_LISTING_PROGRAMMATIC_ACC: If true, describe listing returns based on the listing programmatic access design.
ENABLE_PYPI_REPOSITORY_USER_PUBLIC_GRANT: If true (default), grant pypi_repository_user to PUBLIC. Set to false to opt out.
ENABLE_QUOTA_EVENT_LOGGING: When true, enable quota event logging feature
ENABLE_SCOS_FEATURE: Enables SCOS feature for Snowpark Connect
ENABLE_SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE_ARTIFACT_S: Enable or disable all sharing (link and user-based) for Snowflake Intelligence artifacts at the account level.
ENABLE_SNOWFLAKE_MANAGED_STORAGE_VOLUME_: Enables privatelink access to Snowflake managed storage external volumes
ENABLE_SPARK_APPLICATION_PUSHDOWN_OVERRI: Enable Spark integration. When enabled, configures parameters required for Spark connectivity. When disabled, restores those parameters to their default values.
ENABLE_SPCS_BLOCK_STORAGE_SNOWFLAKE_FULL: Enable enforcement of SNOWFLAKE_FULL encryption for SPCS block-storage volumes and snapshots.
ENABLE_STAGE_S3_PRIVATELINK_FOR_US_EAST_: set to true to generate aws s3 regional URL instead of global s3 urls.
ENABLE_STRUCTURED_TYPES_IN_SNOWPARK_CONN: If enabled, it will act as though ENABLE_STRUCTURED_TYPES_IN_CLIENT_RESPONSE and ENABLE_STRUCTURED_TYPES_NATIVE_ARROW_FORMAT are also enabled, bypassing the driver version check. This parameter is temporary and intended solely for use in Snowpark sessions. Note that there is no validation that the request is initiated from Snowpark when this parameter is on
ENABLE_STRUCTURED_TYPES_NATIVE_ARROW_FOR: If true, in the Arrow ResultSet format, a result column of a structured type would become a column of a corresponding native Arrow structured type (subject to client feature support check). Otherwise, the column would become a string Arrow column that contains JSON representation of its contents. See http://go/structured-types-arrow-resultset .
ENABLE_SYSTEM_SET_APP_VERSION_IN_CURRENT: If enabled for an app package, allow usage of the system function SYSTEM$SET_APP_VERSION_IN_CURRENT_CALL_CONTEXT in its app code
ENABLE_TAG_PROPAGATION_EVENT_LOGGING: A public param to enable logging events during automatic tag propagation
ENABLE_TRI_SECRET_AND_REKEY_OPT_OUT_FOR_: If false, image registry creation will fail for accounts who enabled tri-secret or rekey
Enables block storage and snapshot support for accounts who have enabled tri secret encryption
ENABLE_TRY_CAST_STRUCTURED_TYPES: Enable TRY_CAST for variant to structured type conversions
ENABLE_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTIONS_REPORTING: Enables reporting of unhandled exceptions thrown by UDFs and procedures
ENABLE_UNLOAD_PHYSICAL_TYPE_OPTIMIZATION: Enable physical-type optimizations used in Snowflake to affect the Parquet output
ENABLE_UNREDACTED_QUERY_SYNTAX_ERROR: Enable View Malformed SQL Text feature when parse error occurs
ENABLE_UNREDACTED_SECURE_OBJECT_ERROR: Enable viewing error messages coming from secure objects
ENFORCE_NETWORK_RULES_FOR_INTERNAL_STAGE: Enable the INTERNAL_STAGE mode for type AwsVpceId and IPv4.

The user lineage version of the customer facing account parameter ENFORCE_NETWORK_RULES_FOR_INTERNAL_STAGES used by managed policy migration. Users with this parameter enabled will have managed policy enforced on internal stage. We will deprecate it manually after customer migration is finished.
ENFORCE_NETWORK_RULES_FOR_SNOWFLAKE_MANA: Enable enforcement the SNOWFLAKE_MANAGED_STORAGE_VOLUME network rule mode for type AwsVpceId.
ENFORCE_TAG_PROPAGATION_FOR_DATA_MOVEMEN: If enabled, blocks ALTER TAG SET DATA MOVEMENT POLICY and ALTER TAG SET PROPAGATE when the propagation mode is incompatible with data movement policies, instead of emitting a warning.
ERROR_ON_NONDETERMINISTIC_MERGE: raise an error when attempting to merge-update a row that joins many rows
ERROR_ON_NONDETERMINISTIC_UPDATE: raise an error when attempting to update a row that joins many rows
EVENT_TABLE: Event destination for the given target.
EXEMPT_DISABLE_RISKY_USER: When true, exempts the target from automatic disablement of risky users
EXTERNAL_OAUTH_ADD_PRIVILEGED_ROLES_TO_B: If true, automatically adds the ACCOUNTADMIN and SECURITYADMIN roles the blocked roles set
EXTERNAL_VOLUME: Name of an external volume that will be used for persisted Iceberg metadata and data files.
FALLBACK_WAREHOUSE: If not null, the warehouse to use as a fallback for statements that timed out
FEATURE_ACCESS_REQUEST_ITSM_INTEGRATION: Allows access requests to be routed to a third-party ITSM system. Setting this to ENABLED also enables ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_CONFIGURABLE_PIPELINE, ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_CONFIG_DOCUMENT, ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_WEBHOOK_INTEGRATION, ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_ITSM_WEBHOOK and ENABLE_FIX_WEBHOOK_BODY_SUBSTITUTION_API.
FEATURE_COMMENT_PROPAGATION: When ENABLED, column comments propagate automatically along column lineage. Account admins set DISABLED to turn the feature off for their account, which also turns off the producer-side emission and consumer-side handler gates for COLUMN_COMMENT_CHANGED and LINEAGE_NODE_CREATED.
FEATURE_CORTEX_CODE_SANDBOX: Enable Cortex Code sandbox (microVM isolation for code execution). When ENABLED or ENABLED_PUBLIC_PREVIEW, the Cortex Code CLI auto-activates sandbox mode for the account without requiring the CORTEX_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FEATURES environment variable.
FEATURE_ENABLE_REQUEST_ACCESS_FOR_WORKSP: Enables the workspace access request system functions. Setting this to ENABLED also enables ENABLE_GRANT_APPROVAL, ENABLE_LINEAGE_AWARE_RECIPIENT_CASCADE, ENABLE_REQUEST_ACCESS_FOR_WORKSPACES, ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_HIERARCHICAL_APPROVER_ROUTING, ENABLE_ACCESS_REQUEST_REVIEWER_NOMINATION, and UI_ENABLE_WORKSPACE_ACCESS_REQUESTS. ENABLE_GRANT_APPROVAL_EXPIRY_CLEANER must be set separately at system level.
FEATURE_RBAC_INHERITED_GRANTS: This is feature parameter for RBAC Inherited Grants
FORCE_WORKSHEET_MIGRATION_FOR_ACCOUNT: When enabled, all users in the account are automatically advanced to the final worksheet migration (skipping the manual 'Migrate to Workspaces' click) by the PEP background job.
GEOGRAPHY_OUTPUT_FORMAT: GEOGRAPHY display format: GeoJSON, WKT, or WKB(case-insensitive)
GEOMETRY_OUTPUT_FORMAT: GEOMETRY display format: GeoJSON, WKT, or WKB(case-insensitive)
GO_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to golang driver
GRANT_APPROVAL_REQUEST_EXPIRY_DAYS: Number of days after which a PENDING grant approval request automatically expires. Set to 0 to disable expiry. Maximum value is 30.
HYBRID_TABLE_LOCK_TIMEOUT:
Number of seconds to wait while trying to acquire locks, before timing out and
aborting the statement. A value of 0 turns off lock waiting i.e. the statement
must acquire the lock immediately or abort.
ICEBERG_DEFAULT_DDL_COLLATION: Collation that is used for all new columns created by DDL statements on Snowflake-managed Iceberg tables (if not specified).
ICEBERG_MERGE_ON_READ_BEHAVIOR: Controls merge-on-read behavior on Iceberg tables. Valid values are auto, enabled, and disabled. For 'auto' setting, MoR is enabled by default EXCEPT for v2 managed tables.
ICEBERG_TIMESTAMP_DEFAULT_PRECISION: Default precision for iceberg timestamps when no precision is specified. Valid values are 6 (microseconds) and 9 (nanoseconds).
ICEBERG_VERSION_DEFAULT: Default Iceberg version for new managed Iceberg table creation. Overridden by table-level ICEBERG_VERSION property if specified. Note: the default value must be synced with the default value of ICEBERG_VERSION
INCLUDE_DT_WITH_TABLE_KIND_IN_SHOW_OBJEC: Whether to include dynamic tables, is_dynamic column, table kind in show objects
INCLUDE_DYNAMIC_TABLES_WITH_TABLE_KIND: Whether to include dynamic tables, is_dynamic column, table kind in show commands
INCLUDE_PROTECTED_USER_DATA: When true, ALL_USER_DETAILS returns the display name, the first name, the last name and the email. When false it returns the user names only.
INITIAL_REPLICATION_SIZE_LIMIT_IN_TB: Soft limit for the size of initial replication operation in terabytes. If set to zero, replication operation is not blocked based on size.
JDBC_FORMAT_DATE_WITH_TIMEZONE: When true, ResultSet#getDate(int columnIndex, Calendar cal) and getDate(String columnName, Calendar cal) will display the date using the Calendar's output.
JDBC_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to jdbc
JDBC_TREAT_DECIMAL_AS_INT: When scale is 0, whether to treat Decimal as Int in JDBC
JDBC_TREAT_TIMESTAMP_NTZ_AS_UTC: When true, Timestamp_NTZ values are always stored in UTC timezone
JDBC_USE_SESSION_TIMEZONE: When true, JDBC driver will not display timezone offset between JVM and session.
JSON_INDENT: Width of indentation in JSON output (0 for compact)
JS_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to the JavaScript driver
JS_TREAT_INTEGER_AS_BIGINT: If true, the nodejs client will convert all integer columns to bigint type
LANGUAGE: The selected language that will be used by UI, GS, Query Coordination and XP. The input languages should be in BCP-47 format. AKA. dash format.See LocaleUtil.java for the details.
LISTING_AUTO_FULFILLMENT_INITIAL_REFRESH: Limit on the total size in terabytes allowed for an initial listing auto-fulfillment refresh. Setting this to 0 disables the limit.
LISTING_AUTO_FULFILLMENT_REPLICATION_REF: Listing auto fulfillment replication refresh schedule for listings that do not have a defined refresh schedule
LOCK_TIMEOUT:
Number of seconds to wait while trying to lock a resource, before timing out 
and aborting the statement. A value of 0 turns off lock waiting i.e. the 
statement must acquire the lock immediately or abort. If multiple resources 
need to be locked by the statement, the timeout applies separately to each 
lock attempt.
LOGIN_IDP_REDIRECT: Mapping between interfaces and IdP to redirect to when authenticating into a specific Snowflake interface such as Streamlit or Snowflake Intelligence. The format is a JSON object where keys are interface names (e.g., 'SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE', 'STREAMLIT') and values are IdP names as defined in the SSO integration (e.g., 'Okta', 'AzureAD'). Example: '{"SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE": "Okta", "STREAMLIT": "AzureAD"}'. This is a parameter that will only be set when LOGIN_IDP_REDIRECT account property is set.
LOG_EVENT_LEVEL: LOG_EVENT_LEVEL to use when filtering log events
LOG_LEVEL: LOG_LEVEL to use when filtering events
MAP_SCIM_USERNAME_TO_ENTERPRISE_ATTR: If true, user name needs to be specified as an enterprise attribute snowflakeUserName instead of reading the value from userName attribute. However, login_name of an user will be always mapped to userName attribute.
MAX_CONCURRENCY_LEVEL: Maximum number of SQL statements a warehouse cluster can execute concurrently before queuing them. Small SQL statements count as a fraction of 1.
MAX_DATA_EXTENSION_TIME_IN_DAYS: Maximum number of days to extend data retention beyond the retention period to prevent a stream becoming stale.
METRIC_LEVEL: METRIC_LEVEL value to control whether to emit metrics to Event Table
MIN_DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS: Minimum allowable data retention time for an account. The effective retention time for any entity in the account is the max of this value and the DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS value for that entity.
MIN_STAGE_UNDROP_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS: Minimum allowable STAGE_UNDROP_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS for an account. Effective named-stage undrop retention is max(this, STAGE_UNDROP_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS). Capped by MAX_DATA_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS.
MULTI_STATEMENT_COUNT:
Number of statement included in submitted query text.
This parameter is submitted by user to avoid sql injection.
Value 1 means one statement, value > 1 means n statement
can be executed, if not equal to the value will raise the
exception. Value 0 means any number of statement can be
 executed
NETWORK_POLICY: Network policy assigned for the given target.
NOORDER_SEQUENCE_AS_DEFAULT: Whether we make NOORDER the default option for creating new sequences
NOTEBOOK_VNEXT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_OPTIONS_MINU: Comma-separated list of idle timeout options in minutes for notebooks in workspaces. The first value is the default option pre-selected in the UI.
OAUTH_ADD_PRIVILEGED_ROLES_TO_BLOCKED_LI: If true, automatically adds the ACCOUNTADMIN and SECURITYADMIN roles the blocked roles set
OAUTH_AUTHORIZATION_SERVER: Name of the External OAuth security integration whose issuer authenticates bearer tokens for API resources in this scope. When unset, Snowflake OAuth is used.
OAUTH_SCOPES_SUPPORTED: Comma-separated list of OAuth scopes clients should request when authenticating to API resources in this scope. When unset, Snowflake OAuth defaults to session:role:all.
OBJECT_DESCRIPTION_UI_LANGUAGE: Language for Cortex-generated object descriptions in BCP-47 format (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'ja', 'zh-Hans'). Supported languages: en (English), es (Spanish), fr (French), de (German), it (Italian), pt (Portuguese), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), zh-Hans (Chinese), zh-Hant (Traditional Chinese), ru (Russian), ar (Arabic), hi (Hindi), nl (Dutch), pl (Polish), sv (Swedish), da (Danish), fi (Finnish), no (Norwegian), tr (Turkish), and their regional variants (e.g., en-US, es-MX, zh-CN).
OBJECT_DESCRIPTION_UI_MODEL: Cortex LLM model used for generating object descriptions (e.g., 'llama3.1-8b', 'mistral-7b'). See https://docs.snowflake.com/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/llm-functions#complete for available models.
ODBC_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to odbc
ODBC_SCHEMA_CACHING: When true, enables schema caching in ODBC. This can speed up SQLColumns API calls.
ODBC_TREAT_DECIMAL_AS_INT: When scale is 0, whether to treat Decimal as Int in ODBC
ODBC_USE_CUSTOM_SQL_DATA_TYPES: ODBC return snowflake specific sql data types in result set metadata
OPTIMIZE_DATA_LAYOUT: Enable writing Iceberg data files with random subpaths in the data directory for an Iceberg table
OPT_OUT_ERROR_LOGGING: This is a customer-facing STATEMENT_LINEAGE parameter, the default value is false. When true, ignore the error_logging property specified on the table and do not log errors on the ingestion path (fall back to the original behavior).
PERIODIC_DATA_REKEYING: If true, Snowflake will re-encrypt data that was encrypted more than a year ago.
PIPE_EXECUTION_PAUSED: Pause processing of files for a pipe
PREVENT_LOAD_FROM_INLINE_URL: prevent copy load from inline url (copy into <table> from s3://mybucket/path/f1).
PREVENT_UNLOAD_TO_INLINE_URL: prevent copy into inline url (copy into s3://mybucket/path/f1).
PREVENT_UNLOAD_TO_INTERNAL_STAGES: Prevent unload sensitive data to non-external stages (user stage, table stage, named stage).
PURGE_ON_DROP_TABLE: When set to TRUE on a table, schema, or database in a catalog-linked database, DROP TABLE automatically purges the table's data and metadata files from the external Iceberg catalog.
PYTHON_CONNECTOR_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to python connector
PYTHON_CONNECTOR_USE_NANOARROW: True = Python Connector will use nanoarrow to convert data. False =  client will use vendored pyarrow to convert data.Only affects Python Connector >= 3.3.0
PYTHON_PROFILER_MODULES: A comma separated list of modules to profile in addition to the user code, which is always profiled
PYTHON_PROFILER_TARGET_STAGE: The fully qualified stage name where the profiler output will be saved.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_AUTO_CLEAN_UP_TEMP_TABLE: When True, Snowpark Python client will automatically clean up unused temp tables in the current session. When False, unused temp tables will not be cleaned up until the end of session.
The minimum Snowpark-Python version required for enabling auto clean up of unused temp tables in the current session. If it's an empty string, this improvment is disabled.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_COLLECT_TELEMETRY_AT_CRI: The minimum Snowpark Python version required for enabling reporting telemetry for all SnowflakePlans being executed in the client. If it's an empty string, this improvement is disabled.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_COMPILATION_STAGE_ENABLE: When True, Snowpark Python client will enable the extra compilation stage that appliesoptimizations like repeated subquery elimination, large query breakdown etc.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_DATAFRAME_JOIN_ALIAS_FIX: The minimum Snowpark-Python version required for resovling conflicting alias. If it's an empty string, this improvment is disabled.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_ELIMINATE_NUMERIC_SQL_VA: True = Snowpark Python client will try to eliminate the type cast for numeric literals during query generation for binary expression and in expression. False = Snowpark Python client will always add a type cast for numeric literals for query generation.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_ENABLE_THREAD_SAFE_SESSI: When True, Snowpark Python client will use locks and thread local objects to protect updates of session object.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_GENERATE_MULTILINE_QUERI: True = Snowpark Python client will generate multi-line SQL queries. False= Snowpark Python client will not generate multi-line SQL queries.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_LARGE_QUERY_BREAKDOWN_CO: Parameter to control the complexity score lower bound used by large query breakdown. When the plan complexity is below this complexity bound, the plan node will not be considered a valid candidate for the optimization.

Parameter to control the complexity score upper bound used by large query breakdown. When the plan complexity is above this bound, the plan will be broken down util plan complexity is below is bound, or no valid nodes can be found.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_REDUCE_DESCRIBE_QUERY_EN: True = Snowpark Python client will reduce unnecessary describe queries. False = Snowpark Python client will not reduce unnecessary describe queries.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_REDUCE_DESCRIBE_QUERY_VE: The minimum snowpark-python client version for which the reduce describe query optimization is enabled. If it's an empty string, this improvement is disabled.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_USE_CTE_OPTIMIZATION_VER: The minimum Snowpark-Python version required for enabling cte optimization in the current session. If it's an empty string, this improvment is disabled.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_USE_LARGE_QUERY_BREAKDOW: The minimum Snowpark-Python version required to use the large query breakdown optimization for breaking down complex snowpark dataframe queries into smaller ones for achieving higher performance. When False, do not breakdown the generated sql queries. If it's an empty string, this improvement is disabled.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_USE_LOGICAL_TYPE_FOR_CRE: True = Snowpark Python client will use logical type by default in session.create_dataframe to infer timestamp types correctly. False = Snowpark client will fallback to the old behavior. Only affects Python Snowpark version > 1.10.0
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_USE_OPTIMIZED_SQL_FEATUR: The minimum Snowpark-Python version required for enabling optimized SQL features in the current session. If it's an empty string, this improvement is disabled.
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_USE_SCOPED_TEMP_OBJECTS: True = Python Snowpark will create job scoped temp objects. False = Snowpark will create session temp objects. Only affects Python Snowpark versions > 0.9.0
PYTHON_SNOWPARK_USE_SQL_SIMPLIFIER: True = Snowpark Python client will use the SQL simplifier. False = Snowpark Python client will not use SQL simplifier.
PYTHON_UDF_PROFILER_MODULES: A comma separated list of user-imported modules to profile in addition to the handler code in Python UDF, which is always profiled.
QA_TEST_NAME: Test name if running in QA mode. Used as a diversifier for shared pools
QUERY_ACCELERATION_MAX_STATEMENT_SCALE_F: Maximum scale factor per statement for query acceleration. Limits how many QAS workers a single request can use, expressed as a multiple of warehouse size. Value of 0 means no per-statement limit (warehouse-level limit still applies).
QUERY_CLIENT_TAG: String (up to 2000 characters) used to tag and index queries
QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to client
QUERY_TAG: String (up to 2000 characters) used to tag statements executed by the session
QUOTED_IDENTIFIERS_IGNORE_CASE: If true, the case of quoted identifiers is ignored
READ_CONSISTENCY_MODE: If set to 'GLOBAL', guarantees that changes from different sessions are immediately visible. This option incurs a slight performance impact.
READ_LATEST_WRITES: If true, queries that read hybrid tables will always see the latest committed writes
REPLACE_INVALID_CHARACTERS: Replace invalid UTF-8 characters found in Iceberg table external data files with the Unicode replacement character
REPLICABLE_WITH_FAILOVER_GROUPS: Indicates whether the current object is replicable with a failover group. Default behavior is UNSET. Accepted values are 'YES' and 'NO'(case-insensitive).
REPLICATION_AUTO_RESOLVER_MAX_SIZE_LIMIT: Soft limit for the size of the replication auto-resolver operation in terabytes. If set to zero, replication auto-resolver operation is not blocked based on size.
REQUIRE_CORTEX_SEARCH_INHERIT_DATA_GOVER: If true, CREATE CORTEX SEARCH SERVICE implicitly sets INHERIT_DATA_GOVERNANCE_POLICIES = TRUE when not explicitly specified. Can be set by the account administrator.
REQUIRE_STORAGE_INTEGRATION_FOR_STAGE_CR: If true, only credential-less stage creations are allowed. Can be set by the customer.
REQUIRE_STORAGE_INTEGRATION_FOR_STAGE_OP: If true, only credential-less stages are allowed to be used.  Can be set by the customer.
ROWS_PER_RESULTSET: maxium number of rows in a result set
ROW_TIMESTAMP_DEFAULT: When set to true, new tables are created with row timestamp enabled.
S3_STAGE_VPCE_DNS_NAME: S3 VPCE DNS name to access internal stage bucket over privatelink
SAML_IDENTITY_PROVIDER: Authentication attributes for the SAML Identity provider
SEARCH_PATH: Search path for unqualified object references.
SERVERLESS_TASK_MAX_STATEMENT_SIZE: The maximum warehouse size to use for a serverless Task
SERVERLESS_TASK_MIN_STATEMENT_SIZE: The minimum warehouse size to use for a serverless Task
SERVICE_CALLER_TOKEN_VALIDITY_SECS: Maximum validity period in seconds for service caller tokens. Can be set at the service, schema, database, or account level.
SHOW_EXTERNAL_TABLE_KIND_AS_TABLE: Change the way external table KIND info is displayed by SHOW TABLES and SHOW OBJECTS. The KIND column of external tables is displayed as TABLE if true, EXTERNAL_TABLE otherwise.
SHOW_TERSE_BY_DEFAULT: When enabled, SHOW commands route to MD Fetch SHOW TERSE implementation. Use SHOW FULL to get all columns.
SIMULATED_DATA_SHARING_CONSUMER: Data sharing views will return rows as if executed in the specified consumer account.
SNOWPARK_CONNECT_USE_CTE_OPTIMIZATION_VE: The minimum Snowpark-Connect version required for enabling cte optimization in the current session. If it's an empty string, this improvement is disabled.
SNOWPARK_HIDE_INTERNAL_ALIAS: Display the original column names after automatic aliased by Snowpark client. e.g. Join two dataframes with conflicting column names.
SNOWPARK_LAZY_ANALYSIS: Enable lazy result schema analysis for Snowpark
SNOWPARK_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS: Client side timeout for Snowpark requests in seconds. Currently this parameter only applies to UDF jar (Java/Scala) or zip (Python) file uploading.
SNOWPARK_STORED_PROC_IS_FINAL_TABLE_QUER: If true, it indicates that the query is the final query of table sproc which is used as the result for the client
SNOWPARK_USE_SCOPED_TEMP_OBJECTS: True = Snowpark will create job scoped temp objects. False = Snowpark will create session temp objects. Only affects JVM Snowpark versions > 1.5.0
SNOWSIGHT_USE_DASHED_CLASSIC_UI_URL: Use dashed version of account or alias when constructing classic-ui url
SNOWSIGHT_USE_REGIONLESS_CLASSIC_UI_URL: Use regionless mode when constructing classic-ui url
SNOWWORK_DAILY_EST_CREDIT_LIMIT_PER_USER: Daily estimated credit limit per user for SnowWork usage. A value of -1 means no limit. A value of 0 disables access.
SQL_API_NULLABLE_IN_RESULT_SET: The result set may include JSON null if true, otherwise it includes string 'null'
SQL_API_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: The result set will use the format provided with the default of JSON
SQL_TRACE_QUERY_TEXT: If set to be 'on', we allow collecting query text in sql tracing
SSO_LOGIN_PAGE: Enable federated authentication for console login and redirects preview page to console login
STAGE_UNDROP_RETENTION_TIME_IN_DAYS: Number of days a dropped stage can be restored with UNDROP STAGE
STATEMENT_QUEUED_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS: Timeout in seconds for queued statements: statements will automatically be canceled if they are queued on a warehouse for longer than this amount of time; disabled if set to zero.
STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS: Timeout in seconds for statements: statements are automatically canceled if they run for longer; if set to zero, max value (604800) is enforced.
STORAGE_SERIALIZATION_POLICY: Storage serialization policy used for managed Iceberg table. This include encodings and compressions
STREAMLIT_APP_MAX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Account-admin-configurable maximum idle-timeout (seconds) for Streamlit apps. 0 = no additional cap (system max of 604800 s applies). Valid non-zero range: 86400 (1 day) to 604800 (7 days). Requires ENABLE_STREAMLIT_LIFECYCLE_CONTROLS_FEATURE.
STREAMLIT_EMBEDDING_CONTROLS: YAML document configuring Streamlit embedding controls. Currently accepts an allowed_embedding_domains list; the YAML shape allows additional controls to be added without new parameters. Entries must be https origins, except loopback hosts (localhost, *.localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1), which may also use http (e.g. http://localhost:3000) for local testing. Gated by ENABLE_STREAMLIT_EMBEDDING_FEATURE.
STRICT_JSON_OUTPUT: JSON output is strictly compliant to the specification
SUSPEND_ALERT_AFTER_NUM_FAILURES: Customer-configurable threshold for the number of consecutive failures before auto-suspending an alert. Can be set at ACCOUNT, DATABASE, or SCHEMA level.
SUSPEND_TASK_AFTER_NUM_FAILURES: How many times a task must fail in a row before it is automatically suspended. 0 disables auto-suspending.
TARGET_FILE_SIZE: Target file size for iceberg tables.
TASK_AUTO_RETRY_ATTEMPTS: Maximum Automatic Retries Allowed For A User Task
TELEMETRY_ENABLE_INTERACTIVE_MODE: Deprecated. This parameter is no-op as rowset is now the default when it's available
TEST_ORG_ALIAS_USER_RESOLUTION_PARAM: A test parameter to confirm alter param is supported using org.acct syntax
TIMESTAMP_DAY_IS_ALWAYS_24H:
If set, arithmetic on days always uses 24 hours per day,
possibly not preserving the time (due to DST changes)
TIMESTAMP_LTZ_OUTPUT_FORMAT: Display format for TIMESTAMP_LTZ values. If empty, TIMESTAMP_OUTPUT_FORMAT is used.
TIMESTAMP_NTZ_OUTPUT_FORMAT: Display format for TIMESTAMP_NTZ values. If empty, TIMESTAMP_OUTPUT_FORMAT is used.
TIMESTAMP_OUTPUT_FORMAT: Default display format for all timestamp types.
TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING:
If TIMESTAMP type is used, what specific TIMESTAMP* type it should map to:
  TIMESTAMP_LTZ, TIMESTAMP_NTZ (default) or TIMESTAMP_TZ
TIMESTAMP_TZ_OUTPUT_FORMAT: Display format for TIMESTAMP_TZ values. If empty, TIMESTAMP_OUTPUT_FORMAT is used.
TRACE_LEVEL: Trace level value to use when generating/filtering trace events
TRANSACTION_ABORT_ON_ERROR:
If this parameter is true, and a statement issued within a non-autocommit
transaction returns with an error, then the non-autocommit transaction is
aborted. All statements issued inside that transaction will fail until an
commit or rollback statement is executed to close that transaction.
TRANSACTION_DEFAULT_ISOLATION_LEVEL:
The default isolation level when starting a starting a transaction, when no
isolation level was specified
TWO_DIGIT_CENTURY_START:
For 2-digit dates, defines a century-start year.
For example, when set to 1980:
  - parsing a string '79' will produce 2079
  - parsing a string '80' will produce 1980
UI_ENABLE_TUTORIALS_PAGE: Enables tutorials content on the Learn Page.
UI_FORCE_S3_REGIONAL_DOTTED_ENDPOINTS: UI param to force resolving to S3 dotted regional endpoints
UI_NOTIFICATIONS: Whether UI notifications are shown in the UI
UI_QUERY_RESULT_FORMAT: Format used to serialize query result to send back to python connector
UNLOAD_PARQUET_TIME_TIMESTAMP_MILLIS: Enable this parameter to always unload parquet time and timestamp in milliseconds scale, which are TIME_MILLIS and TIMESTAMP_MILLIS
UNSUPPORTED_DDL_ACTION: The action to take upon encountering an unsupported ddl statement
USER_TASK_MANAGED_INITIAL_WAREHOUSE_SIZE: The initial size of warehouse to use for managed warehouses in the absence of history
USER_TASK_MINIMUM_TRIGGER_INTERVAL_IN_SE: Minimum amount of time between Triggered Task executions in seconds
USER_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS: User task execution timeout in milliseconds
USE_CACHED_RESULT: If enabled, query results can be reused between successive invocations of the same query as long as the original result has not expired
USE_WORKSPACES_FOR_SQL: Set Workspaces as the default SQL editor
VENDED_CREDENTIAL_STORAGE_REGION: GCS region for credential-vended Iceberg tables; bypasses getBucketLocation()
VERSIONED_STAGE_ACTIVE_CHECKPOINT_ALIASE: When set to a non-empty string, workspace PUT operations will create checkpoint versions capturing the pre-modification state of files. Accepts a comma-separated list of checkpoint version aliases. Each alias must start with 'CP$'.
WEEK_START:
Defines the first day of the week:
0: legacy Snowflake behavior; 1: Monday .. 7: Sunday.
WORKSHEETS_MIGRATED: Indicates whether the user has migrated their worksheets to workspace files
